_comment: AdapterContract v0 for the settlement-native-mcp starter (Pass 62). This declaration is what the runtime registers as `aigentsy.settlement_native_mcp.starter` v1.0.0. The validator (`starter_boolean_validator`) accepts ONLY real booleans for the three declared output_fields; non-bool / missing / unknown values are rejected and never enter policy context. When a proof is created with `adapter_id="aigentsy.settlement_native_mcp.starter"`, an AdapterEvaluation is attached to proof.evidence.adapter_evaluation and rides into the signed bundle. Tampering with it breaks bundle_hash. See: protocol/adapter_contract.py.
_layer_boundary: AdapterContract types, validates, versions, and allow-lists adapter-produced signals. AcceptancePolicy is where the user/counterparty defines whether those validated signals add up to acceptable work. AiGentsy enforces the user's policy deterministically against type-validated inputs; it does not decide what counts as good work.
